· Swing Resistance ($370,000) — based on 52-week high, breakout signals a bullish reversal.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) — trend reversal signal unconfirmed, lack of direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.71x) — contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — consider buying upon confirmation of RSI oversold exit and MACD improvement, need to observe short-term resistance breakout.
